The second round of the renowned Veritas Debate League took place at Capital International School, bringing together 100 students from 15 schools to compete, debate, and confidently defend their perspectives.
More than a competition, this league empowers students to build strong character, sharpen critical thinking, and grow in self-confidence while standing firmly by their beliefs.
Concrete is proud to support the entire league, investing in a brighter future and the next generation of leaders.
Keep an eye on the leaders of tomorrow.

Empowering the minds that will shape tomorrow.
Part of the beliefs of Concrete is the investment in our youth; they represent the future of our nation. With this notion Concrete partnered with Veritas the sole Egyptian World School Debate League, where critical thinking meets competition.
We are proud to support the future leaders and critical thinkers of tomorrow. Concrete supports Veritas in the 5 tournaments leading the Egyptian national team to Kenya! 
The first tournament at Hayah International Academy has crowned its champions… and this is only the beginning.
Stay tuned as we celebrate every victory on the road to Kenya.
